name: Your Name
title: Freelance Journalist & Communications Consultant
bio: Freelance journalist and communications consultant with experience spanning investigative reporting, media consulting for UN agencies, strategic communications, and creative writing. MSt in Creative Writing from the University of Oxford.

education.school: Oxford Lifelong Learning, University of Oxford
education.degree: MSt in Creative Writing, Creative Writing
MEDIA, Creative Writing, Documentary writing, Australian media, Media cultures

experience.location: Kampala, Uganda (Remote for San Francisco Bay Area-based team) · Remote
experience.description: Served as Africa correspondent for Spooked, an award-winning radio show and podcast broadcast on over 500 public radio stations, sourcing and pitching compelling true-life stories from across the continent. Leveraged extensive networks of contacts and journalists in Uganda, Ghana, South Africa, Malawi, and beyond. Curated diverse, impactful content that enriched the program's global reach and showcased African perspectives, while conducting fact-checking and providing background materials.

experience.company: DEKOLONIALE Memory Culture in the City
experience.description: Selected as the 2022 Berlin Dekoloniale writing resident, spending three months in Germany using research and interviews to juxtapose Black anti-colonial grassroots activism of the 1930s with contemporary identity and activism in modern Berlin, resulting in a staged reading of debut theatre play 'Greetings from Afar' featured on Deutschlandfunk Kultur and European festivals, and an artistic intervention on migration biases coordinating intercultural teams of actors and designers to co-produce the live performance, with recordings still used in Afro-Diaspora intervention spaces. The project was funded by the Berlin Senate Department for Culture and Europe and the German Federal Cultural Foundation (Kulturstiftung des Bundes), and supported by Berlin Postkolonial e.V., Each One Teach One (EOTO) e.V., ISD-Bund e.V., and Stadtmuseum Berlin Foundation as a collaborative civil society initiative.

Managed a team of volunteers, led weekly meetings, and ensured professional public communications across website, social media, newsletters, and reports aligned with organisational goals. Updated and maintained communication documents, manuals, and databases while working towards advocacy and communications strategies in line with project goals. Liaised with the Director and coordinators on strategy and capacity building for diaspora partners, maintaining high standards in a rights-based human rights-focused NGO.

Supported sales teams and the General Manager VIC to deliver "Intelligent Solutions and Old Fashioned Service," while contributing to smooth office operations through contract processing, CRM data entry, and Microsoft Partner Network administration. Provided ad hoc administrative support to the Sales team and Sales Operations Manager, and maintained the Sales SharePoint section to ensure all sales documentation was current. Coordinated office logistics adhering to ISO9001 procedures.

Established the organisation's national media department, coordinated anti-trafficking public education campaigns, and trained journalists on ethical, victim-centred reporting. Led multi-stakeholder communication efforts, liaising with embassies, government agencies, and UN partners while developing multilingual campaigns addressing exploitation and cross-border protection issues. This work strengthened national awareness on trafficking in persons and demonstrated proven expertise in handling sensitive protection content with trauma-informed, rights-based approaches.

As a correspondent for The East African during its Rwanda launch, covered major developments in business, culture, and the creative industries. Reporting included features and in-depth stories that connected regional policy, economic trends, and community impact.

Worked as a regional freelance journalist producing impactful storytelling on governance, human rights, and social issues, amplifying underrepresented voices and shaping public understanding across the region.

projects.title: Judge – Content is Queen Podcast Micro Grant (remote for UK)
projects.description: Content is Queen is a UK-based audio incubator supporting inclusive storytelling by funding, training, and amplifying underrepresented creators. As a 2025 Micro Grant (volunteer) Judge, assessed up to 50 podcast proposals, scoring submissions using originality, impact, feasibility, and intrigue criteria, and selected the top applications to be considered for funding, studio support, and the opportunity to pitch to Audible.

projects.title: Editor – WCAPS Pipeline Fellowship (remote for USA)
projects.org: Women of Color Advancing Peace, Security & Conflict Transformation (WCAPS)
projects.description: WCAPS is a global organisation advancing the leadership and expertise of women of colour in international affairs. As an Editor (volunteer) for the Pipeline Fellowship, reviewed policy and research paper submissions, providing detailed developmental edits on strengthening clarity, structure, and policy relevance, ensuring submissions met WCAPS' editorial standards while preserving the author's authentic voice.
